email.subject: Family Co Dentistry's site on mobile
email.body:
Hi Maria,

I checked Family Co Dentistry's website. Two things are likely costing you patients: it isn't set up for mobile, so most people searching for a dentist on their phone struggle to even load it, and there's no way to book an appointment online, so anyone ready to schedule outside office hours has to call back later or just picks another practice.

I fix exactly this for local businesses, flat fee, no retainer.

Want a free 10-minute walkthrough showing what I'd change and why? No pressure either way.

Alex
Northlight Web
